description: This PHP script is a performance testing tool for the JmesPath library. It loads test JSON files, runs benchmarks of JmesPath expressions against provided JSON data, and outputs the timing results. It automates the process of running performance suites and manages environment setup, including autoloading and optional Xdebug handling.

methods.name: runSuite
methods.description: Reads a JSON file containing multiple test suites and executes each test case to accumulate total execution time.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a single JmesPath expression against given JSON data multiple times to measure and return the best execution time.
